1778-5006-8170-8249.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Memnite is starting in your graveyard.
1778-5006-8170-8249.description:
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Memnite spell. Then, activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Memnite, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

728-856-3263-6748-6757.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Munitions, as it is a Food due to Ragost.
The Munitions triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-2829-4985-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2829-4985-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Jhoira's Familiar.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Ravager
Repeat.

3617-4863-7370.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Revolutionist.
Resolve Time Walk, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Revolutionist from exile to the battlefield.
When Revolutionist enters, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist // Jetfire, Air Guardian

114-1283-7803.easyPrerequisites: Jetfire has no +1/+1 counters on it.
114-1283-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
114-1283-7803.description:
Activate Jetfire, Air Guardian by paying {3}, converting it and putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, adding {4} and converting Jetfire.
Repeat.

215-527-7296.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 6 or greater.
215-527-7296.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {2}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2279-2292-3240-6462.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Quintorius triggers, creating a Treasure token and creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

801-4871-5173-5626.notablePrerequisites: One of Impulsive Pilferer or Shambling Ghast must be on the battlefield with the other in your graveyard.
801-4871-5173-5626.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying an amount of {E}, sacrificing Impulsive Pilferer or Shambling Ghast and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Impulsive Pilferer or Shambling Ghast dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating two Treasure tokens
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning either Impulsive Pilferer or Shambling Ghast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

914-5530-7487.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-5530-7487.description:
Cast Another Round by paying {2}{W}, blinking Dockside Extortionist and Zealous Lorecaster.
When Dockside Extortionist and Zealous Lorecaster enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Zealous Lorecaster trigger, returning Another Round from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat.
914-5530-7487.notes: If opponents control four or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

4050-5170-6132-7452.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Cauldron of Essence triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Cauldron of Essence trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

856-2921-4321-7422.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-2921-4321-7422.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Garrison Excavator trigger.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

647-3259-7358.easyPrerequisites: You don't control a Devil token.
647-3259-7358.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
647-3259-7358.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Maestros Diabolist as attackers.
Maestros Diabolist triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
If the sacrificed creature was a Devil token, it triggers when it dies, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat each combat phase.

204-1169-1858-2056-2633.description:
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}.
Urabrask and Saheeli trigger.
Resolve the Urabrask trigger, adding {R} and dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Saheeli trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat.

628-997-7194.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Burdened Stoneback.
When Burdened Stoneback dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability
Repeat.

773-1409-3129.description:
Activate Galazeth Prismari by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Galazeth Prismari enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Galazeth Prismari.
Resolve the Galazeth Prismari trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

3532-3536-3594-5078.description:
Declare Cheering Fanatic as an attacker. When it triggers, choose to name "Sensei's Divining Top".
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Toothy triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat from step 2

3200-4195-4311-4574.description:
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Urza's Bauble from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Urza's Bauble from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1315-3293-4826-5721.easyPrerequisites:
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{G}.
You control a Plains.
1315-3293-4826-5721.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all other Emeria Shepherd triggers, returning any number of nonland permanents from your graveyard to either your hand or the battlefield.
Repeat.
1315-3293-4826-5721.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard to the battlefield if you control two or more Plains. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

2921-3734-4375.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Phyrexian Metamorph from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Phyrexian Metamorph enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Phyrexian Metamorph.
Resolve the Phyrexian Metamorph trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Phyrexian Metamorph from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

2457-4094-5794-6705.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect and two 1/1 Frog creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the Frog and Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

856-3899-4321-6462.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-3899-4321-6462.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Kheru Goldkeeper trigger.
Resolve the Kheru Goldkeeper trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

3875-5414-5531-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least two lands between the battlefield and your graveyard.
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
3875-5414-5531-5702.description:
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 3 until you control no lands.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Lumra.
Put the token Lumra into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Tireless Provisioner trigger that many times.
Resolve all Tireless Provisioner triggers, creating at least two Treasure tokens, and then an additional Clue or Treasure token for each remaining trigger.
Holding priority, activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve all but one Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating that many 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

1766-3918-4038.description:
Activate Trazyn using Thran Dynamo's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Trazyn.
Repeat.

372-3277-3647.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Displace exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-3277-3647.description:
Cast Displace by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Izzet Chronarch and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Izzet Chronarch trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Chronarch trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Displace.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Izzet Chronarch and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

953-1371-5919.description:
Cast Enter the Infinite by paying {8}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to copy Enter the Infinite.
Resolve the first opponent's Enter the Infinite, causing the opponent to draw their library, and then put a card on top of their library.
Razorkin Needlehead triggers for each card they draw this way, dealing damage to the opponent equal to the number of cards they drew.
If the opponent has 0 or less life, they lose the game.
Repeat step 3 for each other opponent.

1314-2034-2757-4347.description:
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Misthollow Griffin, untapping a basic Island.
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Misthollow Griffin, adding {C}{C}.
When Misthollow Griffin dies, Brenard triggers, exiling Misthollow Griffin from your graveyard and creating a token copy of it that is a 1/1 Food Golem artifact creature token.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Misthollow Griffin token, untapping a basic Island.
Cast Misthollow Griffin from exile by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Repeat.

1350-2757-3652-5705.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one basic Plains.
1350-2757-3652-5705.description:
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When Ornithopter enters the battlefield, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate a basic Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Ornithopter, untapping the Plains
Activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Eldrazi Spawn, untapping the Plains.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Ornithopter from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

441-2034-3374.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional Kithkin.
441-2034-3374.description:
Cast Kinsbaile Borderguard by paying {1}{W}{W}, causing it to enter the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Antler Skulkin by paying {2}, giving Kinsbaile Borderguard persist until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kinsbaile Borderguard, adding {C}{C}.
When Kinsbaile Borderguard dies, its persist ability triggers, as well as its second ability.
Resolve the second trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Kithkin Soldier creature tokens equal to the number of counters on Kinsbaile Borderguard.
Resolve the first trigger, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to its ability.
Repeat.

413-678-4336.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Kobolds of Kher Keep to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

331-1506-3059.notablePrerequisites:
Burning Anger attached to Malignus.
Malignus does not have summoning sickness.
331-1506-3059.description:
Activate Malignus by tapping it, causing it to deal damage equal to twice its power to an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.
You may repeat this during each of your turns.

1350-2397-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{W}{U}.
1350-2397-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{W}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying {4}{U}.
Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{W}{U}.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
